visual_goal: Show the dependency order: kernel elements first, shared capabilities second, retirement last; Meterline needs customer and vehicle key, the event backbone carries both, and Connect XML retires only after the new API and meter exist.
prompt: A left-to-right dependency illustration in three loose columns. Left column, three blue rounded tiles stacked: 'Tenant directory' at top, 'Vehicle key' in the middle, 'Charter' at the bottom. Middle column, four teal tiles stacked in this order from top to bottom: 'Axleby ID', 'Meterline', 'Event backbone', 'JSON API v2'; 'Event backbone' sits level with 'Vehicle key'. Right column, two tiles: a green tile 'Shared capabilities' level with 'Event backbone', and an orange tile with a small power-off icon 'Connect XML sunset' level with 'JSON API v2'. Exactly nine arrows. 'Tenant directory' has exactly two outgoing arrows: one to 'Axleby ID' and one to 'Meterline'. 'Vehicle key' has exactly two outgoing arrows: one up to 'Meterline' and one straight right to 'Event backbone'. 'Axleby ID' has one arrow down along the right side to 'Event backbone'. 'Charter' has one arrow right to 'JSON API v2'. 'Event backbone' has one arrow right to 'Shared capabilities'. 'Meterline' has one arrow to 'Connect XML sunset', and 'JSON API v2' has one arrow right to 'Connect XML sunset'. Arrows carry no labels. These nine labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Tenant directory feeds Axleby ID and Meterline; the vehicle key feeds Meterline and the event backbone; Charter feeds JSON API v2; the event backbone enables shared capabilities, and Meterline plus JSON API v2 enable the Connect XML sunset.

visual_goal: Show capability map v2 by tier: a compulsory kernel of five capabilities at the base, sixteen shared platform capabilities above, and eighteen half- or product-owned capabilities on top.
prompt: A layered stack illustration of three horizontal bands. Bottom band, dark blue, labeled 'Kernel', containing five equal tiles labeled 'Vehicle key', 'Accounts', 'Authorization', 'Metering', 'Licensing'. Middle band, solid teal, labeled '16 shared', with a short row of six small plain teal squares without text. Top band, solid light green, labeled '18 product-owned', with a short row of six small plain squares in green and orange without text. One arrow from the top band down to the middle band labeled 'by contract'. One arrow from the middle band down to the kernel band labeled 'kernel keys'. One arrow from the top band along the right side down to the kernel band, unlabeled. These ten labels are the only words in the image.
alt: A three-layer stack: a kernel of five capabilities (vehicle key, accounts, authorization, metering, licensing) at the base, 16 shared capabilities above it, and 18 product-owned capabilities on top, consuming shared capabilities by contract and kernel keys.
